threats.title: Spoofed identity headers
threats.summary: A client talks to the app (or forges X-Forwarded-For) and injects Remote-User / Remote-Groups / Remote-Name / Remote-Email.

threats.title: Secret URL as authentication
threats.summary: Publishing an unguessable path or a 'hidden' hostname is treated as access control instead of an IdP with MFA.

threats.title: Brute-force against login
threats.summary: Password or TOTP guessing against the Authelia portal.

threats.title: PostgreSQL / Redis / NATS public exposure
threats.summary: Datastores published on 0.0.0.0 or joined to a public network.

threats.title: Secret leakage
threats.summary: Passwords, hashes, DSNs, or tokens committed, logged, put in URLs, health bodies, or a client bundle.
